concepts.gloss_en: Holiness / the holy (an abstract quality; here linked to chochmah, mochin, chuppah)

members.note: representative; קֹדֶשׁ = holiness, e.g. חכמה בחינת קדש, שאו ידיכם קדש

concepts.gloss_en: The Temple / sanctuary (במקדש = in the Temple, from the mishnaic thumb-counting passage); distinct place-noun, not the abstract quality 'holiness'

members.note: בַּמִּקְדָּשׁ — the Temple locale in Yoma-style census; different lexeme and referent from קֹדֶשׁ 'holiness'

notes: Not the same concept. מקדש (Temple, a place) shares consonants with קדש only via the mem prefix but is a distinct lexeme with a distinct referent; the proof shows במקדש meaning the Temple, whereas קדש means abstract holiness. Under-merge upheld.
